title: Acquirer: Tropical Ice; Target: Nice Ice

body_sections.Summary: Tropical Ice has acquired Nice Ice's business in Townsville.
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market is the market for the manufacture and distribution of ice in Townsville.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Whilst the acquisition crosses the Commission's thresholds for the exercise of market power the Commission considers that it is unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition due to the low barriers to entry and the ability of end-users to manufacture their own ice.
